rule: label is the guide entry (taxonomy/components.json) for the design-system component the element is: the component a designer would place for it in Figma, whatever tag renders it. The class-name hint often names it: a design-system Button rendered as <a href> is label: Button, and a design-system Link rendered as <button> is label: Link. The report finds those tag mismatches itself. When the picture alone would earn a different entry, write that entry in looks_like. Leave label out when you cannot decide: an unlabelled candidate counts towards stability, never towards accuracy. Tools never write label or looks_like.
